watch.summary: The streamer admits his toxic gaming trait is watching esports pros and immediately believing he can replicate their skill.

beats.what: Streamer introduces his toxic trait in gaming.
He claims he watches 100 Thieves pro play and convinces himself he can do it.
He adds that watching any pro play makes him say 'say less'.
He concludes that he immediately hops into a match with unearned confidence.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I'll watch 100 Thieves like this and then I'll be like, yeah I can do this.
watch.why: The clip touches on a universal gaming meme where watching elite pros gives players delusional self-confidence. It delivers a quick, self-deprecating joke with simple commentary and esports background clips.
